method: tests/live_support/q3_q5_filing.py on a fresh CP4-Scratch- copy of IndonesianHC-Complete (production filing path: preview, confirm, filing worker)
question: Q5 (T004, US2 AS-6): file the same scope twice, grammar unchanged -- does the second run (a new process) report every word unchanged?
finding: Yes. Run 2, in a new filing worker process, reports unchanged = 5 of 5 and filed_words = []; the .fwdata is byte-identical before and after run 2. Wordform.Checksum == ParseResult.GetHashCode() holds across processes, so FLEx's own skip works for MCP runs.
defect_found: Before the fix in this run, run 1 was reported completed/persisted while the file on disk was still the pre-run file and the lock was still held: SaveChanges on the XML backend only queues LCM's background commit. filing_commit now saves AND closes (RefreshFromDisk, CloseProject) before answering; verified here: the file changed and the lock was free at the moment run 1 was reported done.
